exercise1.prompt: The column that answers your question usually is not in the file.

hiddenCases.name: a single row is all of the total
the total is computed from the column
hiddenCases.describe: the column total, rather than a number typed in

exercise1.hint: Divide the column by its own sum and multiply by 100. The division broadcasts the single total across every row.

questions.prompt: What happens when you divide a column by a single number?
choices: Every value is divided by it
questions.explain: Broadcasting again: the single value meets every row. A column total divided into the column is the standard "share of the whole" line.

choices: A new table with the column added
questions.explain: It leaves your table alone and hands back a new one, which is what lets it sit in the middle of a chain.

questions.prompt: Why is the column you need often not in the file?
choices: Files record what happened; the question asks about a rate, a share or a difference
questions.explain: A file stores facts. Analysis is mostly the arithmetic between them.
